section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports the psychometric evaluation of a Malay translation of the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in a single community sample of Malaysian Malay and Chinese adults (N = 781). The study tested factor structure, measurement invariance across sex and ethnicity, internal consistency, and construct/incremental validity; no separate 'Study 1' or multiple numbered studies are mentioned in this section.
